trigger.defect: The single woman visibly has three arms: one reaching to the goal board, one central pencil hand, and one holding the selected result.

simultaneousHumanActions: mark one report with a pencil
place one selected report into a final tray
successorGuard.goalTreatment: One already-pinned, untouched nonverbal research-goal card in the background.
successorGuard.computerTreatment: A small bank of bounded workspaces behind the woman, visually subordinate to her review.
failIf: Any third arm, hand or duplicated limb is visible
The woman reaches toward the pinned goal card
More than two simultaneous human actions are depicted
The machine appears to choose the goal or final result
The image collapses back into a generic blank card-laptop-folder pipeline
